notes: Strength values are current, not maximum. A formation that dies is struck from this file and never returns — it moves to fallen instead of lingering here at zero.

formations.name: Oakhand
history: Battle 1 — The Toll Road: won a straight fight against Gatewright.

formations.name: Stonewatch
history: Battle 1 — The Toll Road: never engaged. The fight never reached her side of the line.

formations.name: Marrow
history: Battle 1 — The Toll Road: caught alongside Ferrant when Toll-taker broke both of them at once. Marrow got clear; Ferrant did not.

formations.name: Thistle
history: Battle 1 — The Toll Road: cut down the same Toll-taker that had broken Ferrant and Marrow, then beat Scrip in the same round. The two hardest fights of the battle, back to back.

formations.name: Coldbrook
history: Battle 1 — The Toll Road: reached the field and never took a wound.

formations.name: Harrow
history: Battle 1 — The Toll Road: two shots, two hits — chipped Whistle, then killed Coin outright.

formations.name: Wren
history: Recruited between the Toll Road and Ashweir Bridge. The roster lost every fast, ranged and mounted formation it had — Wren is the archer the last one didn't have to be there in time to become.

fallen.name: Kestrel
fallen.detail: Lost a duel with Tally over the crossing.

fallen.name: Ferrant
fallen.detail: Fought four engagements in one battle — lost the first to Reeve, beat Reeve in the rematch, beat Toll-taker, beat Tally — before Toll-taker and Marrow's stand finally caught her between two enemies at once and broke the formation. No formation in the campaign has yet matched that run. Not everyone who rode with her died there; some of her riders made it off the field, without enough left to hold the name or fight as she fought. The formation does not return to the roster. The riders might turn up again.

fallen.name: Ash
fallen.detail: Lost the three-way scrum for the crossing to Coin.
